map.根据坯体直径与拉坯阶段，推荐拉坯机转速，保持合适的线速度（切向速度）以兼顾成形与: Recommend a potter's wheel speed from the body diameter and the throwing stage, keeping a suitable peripheral (tangential) speed to balance shaping and stability.
map.转速 n = 线速度 v ÷ (π × D)，其中 D 为坯体直径(m)、v 为: Speed n = peripheral speed v ÷ (π × D), where D is the body diameter (m) and v is the wheel rim peripheral speed (m/min); the peripheral speed values for each stage are opening 60 to 90, pulling 40 to 70, and closing 20 to 40 m/min; convert to rpm and round to an integer; the larger the body the lower the speed should be (centrifugal force is proportional to diameter), and when closing large pieces the speed can drop to 60 to 100 rpm to avoid centrifugal deformation.
map.📚 深度解析：拉坯转速计算: 📚 Deep dive: Potter's Wheel Speed Calculation
map.开坯定中心：湿泥含水量高、重心不稳，用较低转速（约 60–100 rpm）稳妥找: Opening and centering: wet clay has high moisture and an unstable center of gravity, so a lower speed (about 60-100 rpm) centers it steadily without flinging clay off.
map.提拉成型：中心稳定后提到中速（约 120–200 rpm）拉高筒身，转速随坯体增: Pulling and shaping: once the center is stable, raise to a medium speed (about 120-200 rpm) to pull up the cylinder wall, lowering the speed moderately as the body grows taller to prevent wobbling.
map.修口收尾：接近口沿与修整阶段可略提速或减速精修，保持坯壁均匀、口沿圆润。: Trimming and finishing: near the rim and during trimming you can slightly raise or lower the speed for fine finishing, keeping the wall even and the rim round.
map.输入泥团 800g、目标碗高 90mm，工具建议开坯 80 rpm 定中心、提拉: Entering an 800g clay lump and a target bowl height of 90mm, the tool suggests opening at 80 rpm to center, pulling at 150 rpm and closing at 120 rpm, and warns that when the moisture content is on the high side the whole range should drop 10%-20%.
map.转速与泥料含水率有关吗？: Is wheel speed related to the clay moisture content?
map.有。泥过湿易甩飞，应降速并先沥水；泥偏干阻力大、易开裂，可略提速并勤补水。以手感: Yes. Too wet clay is easily flung off, so lower the speed and drain first; too dry clay has high resistance and cracks easily, so raise the speed slightly and replenish water often. Go by a stable feel.
map.不同器型转速怎么选？: How do you choose the speed for different vessel shapes?
map.高瘦瓶罐需更稳更低速防晃；宽口盘碟可稍快以利展开。新手从低速起步，熟练后依手感微: Tall slim bottles and jars need steadier, lower speeds to prevent wobbling; wide plates and dishes can be a bit faster to open up. Beginners should start slow and adjust by feel once practiced.
map.新手建议从多少转速开始？: What speed should a beginner start from?
map.建议定中心 60–100 rpm、提拉 120–180 rpm 区间起步，配合均: Start in the range of 60-100 rpm for centering and 120-180 rpm for pulling, with even force and water replenishment; practice on small pieces before scaling up.
